_about: Completion forms the parser accepts that dictionary.md does not list. Each one needs a reason and the evidence that the parser accepts it; internal/parser/completion_forms_test.go checks the parse.

forms.label: tap on
forms.reason: The parser reads `on` as a filler word, so `tap on "Sign In"` is a tap. Used in internal/parser/parser_test.go and internal/runner/runner_test.go. The dictionary lists `tap "Label"`; this is the form written after `tap`.

forms.label: toggle wifi
forms.reason: `toggle` takes any selector, so `toggle wifi` parses as a toggle of a widget labelled wifi (probe lint accepts it). The dictionary's example is `toggle "Dark Mode"`.
